title: Addressing the Reviewer / SME
description: How to write for a reader acting as Reviewer / SME. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `reviewer` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Evidence first
rules.description: Evidence first. State the finding, then the reasoning. Never make them reconstruct an argument to reach a verdict.

source.quote: Reading someone else's change, usually against a deadline, usually without the context that produced it. Needs to know what changed and what it affects before they need to know why.
